messages:
maya: quick copy sanity for the autoscale / burst modal — CTAs feel ambiguous. is the product turning something on or charging users?
liam: same. first read made me think it's a toggle that persists.
alex: FYI this modal appears when a GPU pool hits capacity. intent is to let users temporarily allow extra GPU minutes. we must call out cost and duration clearly.
jordan: rough CTA options to test: ```Primary:
- Enable burst (recommended)
- Reserve burst capacity
Secondary:
- Not now
- Remind me later```
maya: prefer verbs and short labels. but "Reserve burst capacity" sounds like a purchase. worried about surprise billing.
zoe: accessibility note: add aria-describedby linking to the explainer: "Temporarily increase pool capacity. May incur charges." Also ensure tooltip is keyboard-focusable.
liam: what about inline microcopy under the CTA: "Temporary + billed per-minute. Est: $0.12/min." keep it readable and AA contrast.
alex: product wants explicit cost shown (computed server-side). design wants it small but visible.
maya: low-contrast tiny text fails a11y often. proposal: 12px, 3:1 contrast min, and keep wording to one line.
jordan: tooltip content example: "Adds capacity for up to 60 mins. Billed $0.12/min after free tier." keyboard focusable, focus trap off.
zoe: copy candidate for the modal body (full): "Allow temporary burst capacity to handle spikes. Estimated cost: $0.12/min. Charges apply only while burst is active." Visible primary label: "Enable burst" Secondary: "Keep current settings"
liam: prefer "Keep current settings" over "Remind me later" since it's explicit. also add a subtle info icon that opens a longer FAQ.
maya: A/B variants to run: A) Primary: "Enable burst" B) Primary: "Reserve burst" — secondary same. track conversion and support mentions.
alex: agree. implementation notes: server-side to calculate estimate, pass to client; include a data-attribute for analytics clicks.
jordan: I'll mock both copy variants in the modal prototype and add keyboard-touch tests.
zoe: I'll run a quick color contrast check and write the aria text.
maya: action items: 1) jordan prototype both CTAs + tooltip 2) zoe a11y + aria copy 3) alex confirm pricing calc endpoint 4) maya finalize figma copy and push.
liam: ack. thanks team :thumbsup:
meta_note: Design thread: microcopy review for burst/autoscale modal CTAs, cost disclosure, and accessibility action items.
